# Internal incident report 2026-09-19

Our team tracked Operation Goldrush, a campaign operation observed between June and August of this year.
The threat group Gold Alpha was documented in our telemetry during the intrusion.
The malware family GoldM1 was documented in our telemetry during the intrusion.
The tool GoldProbe was documented in our telemetry during the intrusion.
The attack technique Gold Legacy Technique was documented in our telemetry during the intrusion.
The campaign operation Operation Goldrush was documented in our telemetry during the intrusion.
The threat group Gold Beta was documented in our telemetry during the intrusion.

## Findings
- We assess with high confidence that Gold Alpha uses GoldM1.
- We assess with high confidence that Gold Alpha uses GoldProbe.
- We assess with high confidence that Gold Alpha uses Gold Legacy Technique.
- We assess with high confidence that Operation Goldrush is attributed to Gold Alpha.

Indicators of compromise were collected from customer sandboxes and shared with the constituency. No further links between the tooling clusters were identified at the time of writing.
